meta.name: convex-create-component
meta.description: Builds reusable Convex components with isolated tables and app-facing APIs. Use for new components, reusable backend modules, integrations, or component boundary work.

copy.tagline: 构建可复用的 Convex 后端组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Convex 开发后端，需要封装可复用的数据模块和 API。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing with Convex and need to encapsulate reusable data modules and APIs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你创建可复用的 Convex 组件，这些组件拥有独立的数据库表和对外 API。它会引导你规划组件结构、编写代码，并正确连接到你的应用中。
howto.when: 当你提到要创建新的 Convex 组件、提取可复用的后端逻辑、构建第三方集成，或者需要将功能打包到多个应用中使用时，Claude 会主动提供帮助。

say.text: 帮我创建一个通知组件，包含发送和查询未读消息的功能。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤创建组件结构、表定义和函数。

say.text: 我想把用户认证逻辑提取成一个独立的 Convex 组件。
say.note: Claude 会指导你如何分离认证逻辑并保持边界清晰。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create reusable Convex components with isolated tables and app-facing APIs. It guides you through planning the component structure, writing code, and wiring it into your app.
howto.when_en: When you mention creating a new Convex component, extracting reusable backend logic, building a third-party integration, or packaging functionality for multiple apps, Claude will offer assistance.

say_en.text: Create a notification component with send and list unread functions.
say_en.note: Claude will create the component structure, schema, and functions step by step.

say_en.text: I want to extract user authentication logic into a separate Convex component.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on separating auth logic while keeping boundaries clear.
